description: This file contains a CMake script defining a recursive depth-first search (DFS) callback function for parsing nested map and list structures, emitting events for each element and reference type encountered.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: Main function that initiates the DFS traversal with a user-provided callback.

methods.name: dfs_callback_inner
methods.description: Inner recursive function that processes each node, emitting events based on node type and visitation status.
